Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and for sending the questionnaire. A few quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: we completed SOC 2 Type II (security, availability) in Nov 2025. We can share the report under an NDA.
- HIPAA: yes, we require a signed BAA for any workflows that will involve PHI; legal can send a standard starter template.
- Pen test report: we typically accept a redacted executive summary for vendor evaluation; full reports are shared only with a signed NDA and named contacts.
- Vulnerability management: our internal SLA is 72 hours for remediation of Critical issues and 10 business days for High; cadence: monthly external scans + continuous internal scans. Disclosure: coordinated disclosure with our security team.

Can you confirm turnaround for a redacted exec summary and whether you can host the file via a secure share (SFTP or restricted Drive link)? Also, what is the expected time to complete your vendor questionnaire?

Looping in our security lead (security@healthprime.com) for any direct technical follow-up.

Thanks,
Alice Wong
Head of Product & Partnerships, HealthPrime
alice.wong@healthprime.com

Hi Alice / Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick answers from Redwood's security side and what we can provide immediately: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security, availability) in Oct 2025; we can provide the SOC 2 report under NDA.
- Pen test: we run an annual third-party penetration test (most recent: Aug 2025). We can provide a redacted executive summary and TLP:AMBER executive notes today after an NDA. Full report access is provided via a secure, time-limited link to named contacts once an NDA is in place.
- Vulnerability management
  - External scanning cadence: monthly (third-party), internal continuous scanning with weekly triage.
  - Remediation SLA: Critical: 5 business days; High: 15 business days; Medium/Low: tracked per release.
  - Disclosure: coordinated disclosure with the requesting party; we require a point-of-contact and will share PoC specifics only after a signed NDA.

Turnaround: we can prepare and send a redacted exec summary within 2 business days after receiving a signed NDA/BAA and a short request email listing the named recipients. For HealthPrime's questionnaire, please send it back to me directly (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) and I'll prioritize responses.

Sharing method: secure Drive link or SFTP works; we prefer a restricted Google Drive link for ad-hoc sharing and SFTP for larger artifact exchanges.

Next steps:
- Alice: please confirm the security contact(s) who should receive the exec summary and whether HealthPrime legal requires a BAA first.
- Marissa: I will draft a short NDA if needed and share the redacted summary once executed.

Thanks,
